notes.title: Open Beta Has Ended! A Thank You from Chief Rebel
notes.notes: [p]Hello Fellows! [/p][p] [/p][p][b]The [i]Fellowship [/i]Open Beta has ended, and we want to extend our gratitude to all of you for traveling to the Stronghold and going on a slew of dungeon runs![/b] The main purpose of the Beta was to get one final round of feedback before [i]Fellowship[/i] launches on Steam in Early Access on October 16 – and you all definitely gave us a ton of great feedback and support. Thank you all for making the Open Beta a huge success, we really appreciate every single one of you who jumped in! We wish we could extend the Beta (know many of you have asked for that!), but we need to set our sights on getting [i]Fellowship[/i] ready for Early Access launch and implement all the great feedback you’ve given us.  [/p][p] [/p][p]We know the Open Beta had some server issues throughout, meaning so many of you decided to hop in and play. We’re sorry those issues came up, but we worked hard alongside Arc Games to closely monitor and address your reports to ensure you encountered less issues (and jumped into dungeons more quickly!) We’ve been able to identify ways to improve server stability across the board, and rest assured that for Early Access launch we hope to have the servers as stable as possible – so you all can focus on just having fun.  [/p][p] [/p][p]That said, we’re thrilled [i]so [/i]many of you got to try out [i]Fellowship[/i] during the Beta, and our Fellows got to play as Mara (you sneaky rogues) for the first time and experience the new gameplay systems we’ve implemented, including our new matchmaking and group finding systems. Many content creators, including [u][url="https://www.twitch.tv/shroud"]Shroud[/url][/u], [u][url="https://twitch.tv/guzu"]GuzuTV[/url][/u], [u][url="https://twitch.tv/xaryu"]Xaryu[/url][/u], and more, along with [i]World of Warcraft[/i] guilds, including Liquid, Echo and Method, partnered with us and streamed [i]Fellowship[/i], as they squaded up with friends and took on some of the most challenging dungeons.  [/p][p] [/p][p]We loved watching all of you discover your favorite heroes, dungeon strats, and epic gear during the Beta – and we absolutely can’t wait for all you to play the game more in just a few weeks. For now, we’ll be hard at work (and catching up on sleep along the way) to implement your feedback and create a fuller experience for when [i]Fellowship [/i]launches on Steam in[i] [/i]Early Access! Make sure to continue to tune into our [url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]Discord[/url] and social channels for updates leading up to Early Access launch, including new trailers.  [/p][p] [/p][p]We look forward to you all jumping into [i]Fellowship[/i] again pretty soon when the game releases on Steam in Early Access on October 16! [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Chief Rebel[/p]

notes.title: Open Beta Maintenance - September 19, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello Fellows![/p][p]We have identified a potential improvement for our servers and will be taking the game into maintenance mode at 12:30pm PT.[/p][p]We'll let you all know when we're Live again![/p][p]We will keep queues a bit slower once we're up and running again so we don't slam the servers. Our team will be back in the office tomorrow to continue working on things![/p][p]Thank you all again for your ongoing support and patience as we sort things out[/p]

notes.title: Open Beta Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi Fellows - Thanks so much for your patience and understanding as we try to resolve the server and queue issues we've experienced today. Trust us, we want you all to successfully get into the Beta -- we know you all have been waiting for it![/p][p]Wanted to share an update the investigation surrounding the issues is still ongoing, and we're looking into every possible way of getting this resolved as quickly as possible. We've been actively investigating the issues since Open Beta began, and needs a slight break to rest for a few hours (it's late in Sweden!) After some much needed rest, tomorrow, we will continue to troubleshoot and hope to resolve the issues.[/p][p]Thanks again for all of your support, and we hope everything will be resolved tomorrow so you all can jump into the Beta![/p]

notes.title: Open Beta Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/14835b4f8352099f7caf80e1f071918054a3f53d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fellowship’s Open Beta via Steam is NOW LIVE! Join the Beta today![/b]  Jump in the Beta by clicking on the “Join the Playtest” button on Fellowship’s Steam page. The Beta is available to everyone (yes, everyone!) and we have it running 24/7 every day from now until Tuesday, September 23 at 10am PT. Don’t miss your chance to see how Fellowship has evolved since its last public playtest. Check out the below Open Beta FAQ before you jump in the Beta.   After our last public playtest during Steam Next Fest back in February – and landing a top 5 spot in the “[url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfestmostplayed_feb_2025"]Steam Next Fest: Most-Played Demos[/url]” list (thanks to you all!) – we’re thrilled to launch the Fellowship Open Beta on Steam today! With your help in multiple closed playtests over the past months the game has evolved a lot, and this Open Beta will be one more opportunity to get your community feedback before we enter Early Access on October 16th. We hope you’ll have a ton of fun playing, and we’re looking forward to your feedback [url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]on our Fellowship Discord[/url].  We’ll see you in-game in the Beta, Fellows!   Don’t forget, Fellowship will be available on Steam in Early Access on October 16 for $24.99. Make sure to wishlist the game today!  [/p][h3][b]Open Beta FAQ[/b][/h3][p][b]There really is no signup, payment or key required?[/b] [/p][p]Correct, there is no need to sign up, key or fee required for the Open Beta! It's open to everyone!  [/p][p][b]How do I get into the Open Beta?[/b] [/p][p]During the time of Open Beta from September 18 to September 23, you can head to Fellowship’s Steam page, click the “Join the Fellowship Playtest” to download the Open Beta build, and once it’s downloaded, you can jump in and play.  [/p][p][b]When can I play exactly?[/b] [/p][p]The Open Beta runs from today, September 18 at 10am PT (7pm CEST) to September 23 at 10 am PT (7pm CEST) and Fellowship will be fully playable for that whole time.  [/p][p][b]Can I stream/capture my gameplay?[/b] [/p][p]There is no NDA for this Open Beta. Streaming/video capture and talking about the playtest is highly encouraged!  [/p][p][b]What's ArcLite? It popped up when I clicked "Play" on Steam to go into the Beta.[/b][/p][p]ArcLite is the launcher for [i]Fellowship[/i]. Through ArcLite, you can access the latest news, events, rewards, and community updates—all focused around [i]Fellowship[/i]. Please see the ArcLite FAQ below for more details on ArcLite.[/p][p][b]What Heroes are available?[/b] There are 7 heroes for players to choose from during the Open Beta: 2 Tanks, 3 DPS, and 2 Healers. We’ll most notably have a new Melee DPS, Mara, available, and be bringing back Ardeos, everyone’s favorite fire-throwing DPS! Tariq is not available in this Beta. [/p][p][b]Is there any new content in the Open Beta compared to the last playtest back in February?[/b] [/p][p]There is! Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta introduces new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta introduces a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta allows us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.  [/p][p][b]What servers are available?[/b][/p][p]There are NA, EU, and Asian servers available during the Open Beta.  [/p][p][b]Will my Open Beta progress carry over to the Early Access version of the game?[/b][/p][p]It will not. [/p][p][b]What languages are the Open Beta available in?[/b] [/p][p]The Open Beta is available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Chinese. The game will launch in your chosen Steam language or default to English if it’s not supported.  [/p][p][b]How do I share my feedback?[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]Join our Discord![/url] Feedback can be shared in the ⁠#game-feedback channel. [/p][p][b]What do I do if I encounter an issue during the Open Beta?[/b] [/p][p]As this is still a Beta build, you may occasionally encounter issues with your game. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel on Discord so our teams can track them.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]ArcLite FAQ[/b][/h3][p][b]What is ArcLite?[/b][/p][p]ArcLite is the launcher for [i]Fellowship[/i]. Through ArcLite, you can access the latest news, events, rewards, and community updates—all focused around [i]Fellowship[/i].[/p][p][b]Will ArcLite run in the background while I’m playing the game?[/b][/p][p]No. Once you launch [i]Fellowship[/i] through ArcLite, the launcher will automatically close.[/p][p][b]Heard there's an in-game award I can get through ArcLite? What is the reward and how do I get it?[/b][/p][p]The reward is for [i]Fellowship[/i] players who verify their email when opening ArcLite. Simply enter your email address, complete the verification process, and the reward will be granted to you. The reward is an exclusive in-game mount, Arcalian Steed (check it out below!) [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/39beed6c41d553afaa9e56622c06df4708b202bc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Will this reward carry over to the Early Access version of the game?[/b][/p][p]The reward will automatically be re-granted to your account when you purchase the Early Access version of the game. [/p][p][b]Do I need to create an Arc account to play the game?[/b][/p][p]No. You do not need to create an Arc account to play [i]Fellowship[/i]. Email verification is completely optional.[/p][p][b]I already have the Arc application from another game. Will it interfere with ArcLite?[/b][/p][p]No. ArcLite and Arc are independent applications and do not interfere with each other.[/p][p][b]I'm running into technical difficulties. Where do I seek support?[/b][/p][p]You can click the [b]Support[/b] option under the Arc icon in the top left corner of ArcLite, or simply visit [url="https://support.arcgames.com"]support.arcgames.com[/url] to create a support ticket.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fellowship Launches In Early Access On October 16!
notes.notes: [h3][b]We’re excited to announce that Fellowship will be available on Steam in Early Access on October 16, 2025 for $24.99.  [/b][/h3][h3][b]Before Early Access launch, you’ll be able to play during our Open Beta via Steam from September 18 until September 23![/b] [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]ABOUT EARLY ACCESS[/b][/h3][p]The upcoming Early Access launch will mark just the beginning of Fellowship, as the game will be a constantly evolving adventure with a slew of content that will be added and evolve thanks to YOUR feedback throughout the course of Early Access. Our community comes first, and we take pride in working very closely with our most dedicated fans to create and shape the game over the various stages of development.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/4fdaec1d4676bb5be527325a38b2824d332a6de6.jpg"][/img]From the very beginning of Early Access, you will be able to experience the core vision of Fellowship: all dungeons, all the time – giving you the action you want right from the start. Following Early Access launch, there are plans for optional cosmetic purchases to be available. We'd like to make clear that these items will be purely cosmetic and not affect gameplay. More details on these items will be revealed sometime closer to Early Access launch.  Fellowship is planned to be in Early Access for approximately six months, but this can change depending on your feedback – as we will strive to discover what the community wants in Fellowship to help shape it into the best possible game it can be before it enters 1.0 launch next year. For the full 1.0 version of the game, we're planning on including more content, systems, and features. We have several plans in mind for content and features, but as mentioned before, we will also take your feedback to heart and may make adjustments if we hear that there’s something you really want to see in the game!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/3040363ade798883517171db7b550fc8604dc13d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]JOIN THE OPEN BETA![/b][/h3][p]Our upcoming Open Beta on Steam will kick off on [b]Thursday, September 18 at 10am Pacific Time and end on Tuesday, September 23 at 10am Pacific Time[/b]. For the Open Beta, there will be a North America, Europe and Asia server available. This playtest will you the chance to experience seven heroes (two Tanks, three DPS – including our recently-revealed DPS, Mara, and two Healers) who will be in Fellowship’s diverse roster of heroes, go on dungeon runs (both Ranked Dungeons and Quick Play Dungeons), take on challenging enemies and acquire epic loot along the way.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/9beccea2429425d0333f34ed82645e33c1153127.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta will introduce new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta will introduce a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta will allow us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/fa56cf93dc479e395255e186883fd1a7f97193bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to let us know your feedback as well, please [url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]join our wonderful community on Discord[/url]. In addition to discussing the game with fellow fans and finding players for dungeon runs, our dedicated feedback channel will be available for your input, and the dev team can’t wait to hear from you!  [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steam China Showcase: New Player Guide
notes.notes: Hamish, Community Director of Chief Rebel, has prepared a special beginner's guide to help players who have never played similar games to Fellowship get started quickly. This guide will help players smoothly immerse themselves into this multiplayer online dungeon adventure during the Steam China Showcase!

notes.title: Fellowship Closed Alpha now live in China!
notes.notes:
The Closed Alpha playtest for Fellowship, as part of the Steam China Showcase, is now live and running until September 30! Following our recent Closed Alpha playtest in North America and Europe, we are thrilled to give players in China the opportunity to experience the game as well. We're looking forward to getting their feedback!

If you have been part of our inaugural Closed Alpha playtest in August, you may have received a notification that your playtest access has been revoked. This is just a technicality and a necessary step due to how these playtests for different regions are set up. In case of a future playtest in your region, you remain registered and will receive a notification via email!

Thank you for your patience and understanding, and if you haven't already, feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/playfellowship]join our Discord[/url] to discuss Fellowship with the community!

notes.title: Closed Alpha Patch Notes, August 19
notes.notes:
[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] As Fellowship only works while you are running the Steam client on your computer, the game will now check if Steam is running and message you if it is not.
[*] The "F1, F2, F3, F4" keys on your keyboard should now correctly select allies in your party in the corresponding position in the party frame.
[/list]
[b]GROUP FINDER[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve heard and appreciate your feedback on the Group Finder feature. Today's patch includes a few fixes that hopefully will alleviate some of the issues you have been experiencing. There are some bigger fixes needed to address all the great feedback you have given which we unfortunately will not have time to get in for this Alpha Test.
[*] Declining applications no longer generates duplicates in the application window.
[*] When a player is declined a Group Application, there is no longer a pop-up confirm window. It is now messaged through the Chat instead (to avoid having to confirm each decline individually).
[*] There is a new "Auto-refresh" check box in the Group Finder when you create a group that you can toggle "off".
[*] There is also a new "Refresh" button for manually refreshing the Group Finder instead of automatically.
[*] Additional fixes have been made so the Group Finder now shows the correct heroes of each group.
[/list]
[b]THREAT[/b]
[list]
[*] Baseline threat generation for Tanks has been doubled.
[/list]
[b]HELENA[/b]
[list]
[*] Baseline efficiency of Toughness has been increased by 33%.
[*] Shield Slam target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5) and Shield Slam cleave range has been increased.
[/list]
[b]MEIKO[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of damage each stone from the Stone Shield ability can mitigate before being destroyed has been increased by 33%.
[*] Lashing Stormkick target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5) and Lashing Stormkick cleave range has been increased.
[*] Gust is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Taunt is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Stone Stomp target cap has been increased to 20 (was 5).
[/list]
[b]RIME[/b]
[list]
[*] Winter Crash damage radius has been increased by 40%.
[*] Frigid Torrent damage has been increased by 30%.
[*] Frozen Shield is now off the Global Cooldown.
[/list]
[b]SYLVIE[/b]
[list]
[*] Yellow Flutterfly duration has been increased to 16 seconds (was 8 seconds).
[/list]
[b]VIGOUR[/b]
[list]
[*] Chastise mana cost reduced to 6 (was 18).
[*] Righteous Blast mana cost reduced to 18 (was 28).
[*] Word of Blessing healing increased by 40%.
[*] Blessed Orator talent now increases duration of active Word of Blessings by up to 10 seconds (was 6 seconds) upon casting Righteous Blast.
[*] Baseline spirit generation increased by 30%.
[*] Condemn Holy Orb generation increased by 40%.
[*] Avatar of Faith's duration has been increased to 9 seconds (was 6 seconds).
[*] Avatar of Faith's initial heal upon activation increased by 256%.
[*] The range of Vigour's abilities have been increased to be in line with Sylvie's ability range (almost doubled in some cases!).
[/list]
[b]ARDEOS[/b]
[list]
[*] Engulfing Flames' damage increased by 15%.
[*] Engulfing Flames' chance to generate Ember on tick increased to 20% (was 15%), and the amount of Ember generated has been increased by 42.5%.
[*] Searing Blaze damage reduced by 10%.
[*] Agonizing Blaze talent now increases damage dealt by 3% per stack (was 4%).
[*] Flicker Step is now off the Global Cooldown.
[*] Flame Shield is now off the Global Cooldown.
[/list]
[b]NIGHT PATROL[/b]
[list]
[*]Warlord Wogg's Lost Soul ability now ticks every 2.0 seconds (was 1.5 seconds) and has a total duration of 8 seconds (was 9 seconds).
[*] Warlord Wogg's Demonic Lash ability is now interruptable.
[*] Warlord Wogg now summons 2 Invokers to aid in the battle (was 2 Man-catchers).
[/list]
[b]ASCENSIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] The Ultimatum ascension now increases boss damage and health by 15% (was 20%).
[/list]
[b]CURSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Bloodshard damage reduced by 30%.
[*] Binding Ice damage reduced by 50%.
[*] Binding Ice now occurs 20% less frequently.
[/list]
[b]ARMOR SET BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] The Mirror Knight's/Sunspeaker's/Dunestalker's set - The 2-set bonus that increases/reduces Threat has been increased to 15% Threat (was 5%).
[*] The Deathchaser's/Sinner's set - The 2-set bonus that increases Max Mana has been increased to 15% Max Mana (was 10%).
[*] The Infernal/Blasphemer's/Bloodsworn set - The 5-set bonus that procs Cooldown Reduction has been reduced to 15% Cooldown Reduction (was 20%, tooltip incorrectly stated 30% before this patch).
[/list]

notes.title: The Closed Alpha Playtest is live now!
notes.notes:
Our Closed Alpha playtest on Steam is now live! This playtest will give you the chance to experience six heroes (two Tank, two DPS, two Healer heroes) that will be in Fellowship’s diverse roster of heroes, go on dungeon runs, take on challenging enemies and acquire epic loot along the way.

[b]When exactly can I play?[/b]

The North America server for the playtest will be available from 10am to 5pm Pacific Time from August 15 to August 20. The Europe server will be available from 2pm to 9pm UTC from August 15 to August 20.

[b]What content is available to play?[/b]

This is an early version of the game that is still in development. Next to six available heroes, you can experience four Adventure Dungeons, three full-size Dungeons, dungeon modifiers, hero talents, loot, and a first iteration of your Stronghold.

[b]Can I stream my Closed Alpha gameplay?[/b]

No. This playtest will be under NDA, which you’ll have to agree to during sign-up. Publicly streaming, recording or sharing any content from the game is not allowed for this Closed Alpha.

[b]How can I share my feedback?[/b]

Your feedback is extremely valuable to us. A feedback survey will be emailed to you shortly after the Closed Alpha playtest concludes. We’re looking forward to hearing about your experience! If you have bugs to report or feedback to provide right away, please do so in the appropriate channels [url=https://discord.gg/6xrCTVbMj2]on our Discord[/url].
